headline: News of Prabowo and MSCI Head Talking on the Phone, Rosan Says This
summary: BPI CEO Rosan Roeslani said Prabowo and MSCI discussed communication by phone. He stressed the importance of capital market system improvements by the financial regulator OJK.
why: MSCI index classification decisions affect passive fund flows into Indonesian equities, so the regulator's market reform is closely watched by investors.
original_headline: Kabar Prabowo dan Bos MSCI Bicara di Telepon, Rosan Bilang Begini
